paper.title: Ab-initio simulation of excited-state potential energy surfaces with transferable deep quantum Monte Carlo
paper.authors: Zeno Schätzle, P. Bernát Szabó, Alice Cuzzocrea, Matěj Mezera, Frank Noé

results.system_description: Ethene at the geometry 'Barbatti torsion 0 deg', all electrons, 8 up and 8 down electrons, clamped nuclei
results.variant: Psiformer-derived DeepQMC ansatz, transferable across the 9 torsion geometries, 2 singlet states with a shared electron-nucleus transformer and dynamic state ordering
results.source_location: Supplementary Table (tab:ethylen), torsion angle 0, column A^1_g (ground state)
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the paper's own ansatz trained transferably across the torsion geometries (one optimization for 'the 1D PESs along the torsion (9 geometries)'); multi-state, multi-geometry training is eligible under P5 (2026-11-02).
results.notes: The paper takes the torsion geometries from Barbatti et al. 2004 ('torsion (9 geometries) ... of ethylene [barbatti2004]') and prints them as a parametrized table (tab:ethylen_geom), with the planar C at +-0.6750, H at x = +-1.2429 and z = +-0.9303 angstrom: the same structure as the instance (Barbatti planar geometry, H z = 0.93037 in arXiv:2203.09472v3 Supp. Table I and in the NES-VMC code release) to the 4 decimals printed, the H z coordinate differing by 7e-5 angstrom. Geometry: the planar ethylene of Barbatti, Paier and Lischka (2004), printed in arXiv:2203.09472v3 Supplementary Table I, with the torsion angle tau varied 'while keeping all other geometric parameters fixed' (2203.09472v3, Results): the CH2 group on the +x carbon is rotated rigidly about the C-C axis, as in the code release of Pfau et al. (google-deepmind/ferminet, ferminet/configs/excited/twisted_ethylene.py) and the parametrized table of arXiv:2503.19847v2 (tab:ethylen_geom); coordinates rounded to 1e-6 angstrom. Singlet, N_up = N_down = 8. The singlet states are targeted with a spin penalty. The error bar's meaning is not stated.
